description: A self-balancing two-wheeled robot built as an autonomy testbed. The real-time layer, a Rust LQR balance controller and a collision guard, is written for a Pico 2. A Raspberry Pi 5 handles camera perception and SLAM, and a servo-swept time-of-flight sensor scans for mapping. In Gazebo simulation, the stack balances, drives on command, avoids obstacles, solves mazes, stands back up after a fall and builds a map, and each layer is scored against ground truth. Next: real SLAM, and printing the robot. Drag to explore the full CAD model in 3D.
